title: NVIDIA Motion + Body Studio
kicker: ARDY TEXT MOTION · SOMA-X PARAMETRIC HUMANS
hero: Direct motion, bodies, and robots—not black boxes.
description: Generate constrained text-to-motion with every released ARDY Core/G1 horizon, inspect the exact skeleton interactively, and author native SOMA-X bodies and hands from one private workstation surface.
guide: Core is the expressive human rig; G1 emits simulation-ready MuJoCo qpos. Long-horizon models favor continuity while Horizon8 variants react faster. Use SOMA-X for rigged identity geometry and LOD-controlled exports.
runtime_contract: RTX 5090 · CUDA-only model residency · offline after setup
residency: One queued GPU job; models released after each job

models.label: SOMA-X body, hand, procedural rig + correctives

setup_steps: Start with `./startwithuv.sh`; the listener is loopback-only unless explicitly configured.
Generate a Core proof at five seconds, inspect the skeleton player, then increase duration or add a native ARDY constraint list.

controls.prompt: A person takes three confident steps forward, turns naturally, and gives a friendly wave.
A person reacts with surprise, steps back, then points to the left.

presets.title: G1 locomotion
presets.description: Robot motion plus MuJoCo qpos CSV.

controls.prompt: The humanoid robot walks forward, pivots ninety degrees, and comes to a stable stop.

presets.title: Motion-driven body
presets.description: Mid-LOD corrected body replaying an uploaded Core motion.

modes.title: Direct ARDY motion
modes.short: Text-to-human or Unitree G1 motion with native constraints.
modes.description: Runs the released ARDY diffusion stack and merged high-fidelity INT8 LLM2Vec encoder. Select every shipped skeleton/horizon, keep autoregressive context bounded, condition on key constraints, and receive the native NPZ plus a zero-dependency interactive skeleton.
modes.output_label: Interactive skeleton + NPZ + optional qpos CSV
modes.recipe: Long horizons prioritize continuity; Horizon8 follows changing intent more aggressively. G1 postprocessing is intentionally bypassed upstream and exports simulator qpos.

fields.label: Describe movement, timing, intent, and transitions
fields.default: A person walks forward with relaxed confidence, turns to the right, and waves.

options.label: Core · Horizon 8
options.description: 20 FPS · faster response to intent changes.

fields.label: ARDY constraint list · optional
fields.hint: Joint position/rotation constraints are validated against the chosen skeleton and duration.

fields.label: Human foot cleanup
fields.toggle_label: Reduce Core foot skating after diffusion
fields.hint: ARDY deliberately ignores this for G1.

modes.title: Motion inspection deck
modes.short: Open any compatible ARDY NPZ in the native skeleton player.
modes.description: A diffusion-free path for reviewing joints, timing, root trajectory, contacts, and prompt metadata. It preserves the original NPZ and creates only a bounded browser representation.
modes.recipe: Use this to review old generations or files made by scripts/generate.py before sim export.

modes.title: SOMA-X body forge
modes.short: Author a native parametric human with production LODs and correctives.
modes.description: Runs NVLabs' procedural SOMA rig on the GPU. Shape coefficients remain explicit, poses are named, the corrected mesh exports to GLB, and every native array remains available for DCC or simulation work.
modes.recipe: Start at low LOD while exploring identity, then export mid LOD with procedural twist joints and pose correctives for final work.

modes.title: Motion-driven body
modes.short: Drive the native SOMA-X body with any ARDY humanoid motion and export a skinned GLB.
modes.description: Re-solves every mapped ARDY joint target against the fitted SOMA topology, runs the native forward kinematics, and binds the rigged body skin so the exported GLB plays the full clip in this studio's canvas or any glTF viewer.
modes.output_label: Skinned animated GLB + native pose arrays
modes.recipe: Upload the NPZ from a Direct ARDY motion job; G1 robot clips are rejected because they have no humanoid correspondence. The body is rebuilt at the chosen LOD and the clip stays solver-aligned to the native skeleton.

fields.label: ARDY motion NPZ
fields.hint: Core 27-joint motions map fully; SOMA-native 30/77 joint motions map by exact names.

modes.title: SOMA-X hand lab
modes.short: Shape and articulate the released 25-joint hand topology.
modes.description: Build either native hand at mid, low, or XLO resolution. Independently direct curl, finger spread, thumb opposition, wrist orientation, identity PCA, and global scale.
modes.recipe: Use low LOD while balancing curl and spread; switch to mid for the final GLB.
